_doc: VAT bake set for the far crowd tier (tools_qa/living_world/vat_bake.gd). fps: rows per second (the shader interpolates between rows). target_tris: reduced mesh size (LOD picked from ImporterMesh.generate_lods on the _lod1 model). A clip missing from the rig is skipped with a warning. Clip sets are kept short: every clip costs vertex_count x frames x 12 bytes of texture per look. Budget: ~2 MB of texture per adult look (~1300 tris, 6 fps interpolated; the next meshoptimizer LOD, ~680 tris, collapses feet and hands into spikes); LOW loads only the looks VatResidents needs near the player.
